name: usage-awareness
description: Lets Claude see its own rate limits, reset times, session cost and extra-usage credits, warns it at milestones, and enforces per-session spend ceilings you set.

warnPercent.title: Warn at %
warnPercent.description: First heads-up: start wrapping up and plan a checkpoint.

criticalPercent.title: Critical at %
criticalPercent.description: Save progress now and ask before continuing into extra usage.

allowExtraUsage.title: Allow extra usage by default
allowExtraUsage.description: When false, the mod blocks once a window is exhausted until you lift it with /usage-aware lift.

enforce.title: Enforce ceilings
enforce.description: When true, a hard ceiling denies tool calls and aborts the running turn. When false, the mod only warns.

pollMinutes.title: Usage endpoint poll interval (minutes)
pollMinutes.description: How often to refresh per-model windows and extra-usage credits from the claude.ai usage endpoint.
